hook: A group built from SL2 over Z/p^9 is a counterexample to Kourovka Problem 21.7.
summary: The paper proves that the kernel of SL2(Z/p^9) to SL2(F_p) is not IYB, while its product with a cyclic group is, which yields a supersoluble group with IYB Sylow subgroups that is not IYB. The proof rules out a pre-Lie multiplication using three trace identities. It holds for primes above 24, and the smallest odd-order example it names is of order 3 times 31^32.
title: A congruence-group counterexample to Kourovka Problem 21.7
